item.description: The quantum computing sector has seen no shortage of hype this year, and now one of the industry’s largest gatherings—Quantum World Congress—is set to give stocks another push. Shares of quantum computing companies rallied in the lead-up to the conference, which bills itself as “the world’s premier event uniting the global quantum ecosystem.” The ETF was up slightly on Wednesday, the inaugural day of the event, resisting a downturn in technology stocks.
